prompt: During whose papacy did Gian Lorenzo Bernini create the "Ecstasy of Saint Teresa"?
answer: Gian Lorenzo Bernini created **The Ecstasy of Saint Teresa (1647–1652) during the papacy of Pope Innocent X** (r. 1644–1655). It was commissioned by Cardinal Federico Cornaro for the Cornaro Chapel in Santa Maria della Vittoria, Rome.
